title.narrative: Renewable Energy Innovation Fund - Innovative finance for cleantech solutions in Uruguay's renewable energy sector

description.narrative: The proposed Joint Programme (henceforth JP) for Uruguay is part of the interagency work in the framework of the UN Reform leaded by the UN Resident Coordinator at the field level. The current project #Innovative Finance for Clean Tech Solutions in Uruguay´s Renewable Energy Sector: The Renewable Energy Innovation Fund (REIF)# will be submitted for consideration to the SDG Joint Fund for Innovative Finance (UN competitive window). This process is being coordinated by the UNRC in Uruguay with UNIDO technical leadership and responsibility for the Pro-Doc drafting. The initiative counts with the support and endorsement of the Ministry of Industry, Energy and Mining of Uruguay. DFI´s, CAF and IADB also expressed their commitment to join the effort..
